title: The Keeper's Log Had an Entry From Tomorrow #shorts
desc:
LAMPLIGHT, an unreleased PS2 lighthouse game. You write every boat in the keeper's log. The last keeper's final line: eight boats, and one for Rowe. 3 March 2004.

Full story on the channel: The PS2 Lighthouse Game That Counts One Boat Too Many (LAMPLIGHT, Dead Pixel Studios).

Fiction. PS2-era low-poly visuals, synthetic narration.
#shorts #analoghorror #ps2 #lostmedia
